newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Realty sets annual meeting date.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Realty sets annual meeting date.

text.p: Cardinal Realty Services Inc said Wednesday its annual meeting of shareholders is scheduled for October 7.
The record date for shareholders entitled to receive notice of and vote at the meeting is August 26.
At the annual meeting, shareholders will be asked to consider and approve proposals to change the company's name to Lexford Inc and adopt its 1997 Equity Performance Plan.
Cardinal said the equity performance plan will provide for equity awards of common stock to its executives and directors if stock price or financial performance targets are met.
